summary: Harrison Global Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting unanimous board resolutions adopted September 22, 2026. The board approved a 1-for-1,000 reverse split of Class A Ordinary Shares, reducing issued shares from 49,583,207 to 49,583, with Class B shares unchanged at 50,000,000 authorized and issued. The board also approved four divestitures: Asia-Pacific Stablecoin Digital Asset Trading Group Limited to Mr. Ryoshin Nakade for HK$1,000; K.K. BloomZ to Asia-Pacific Stablecoin for JPY 100,000; BloomZ Limited to Asia-Pacific Stablecoin for HK$1,000; and ECRUX INC. to Asia-Pacific Stablecoin for US$1,000. Additionally, Minoru Muranaga ceased as CFO, while Ryoshin Nakade was appointed Co-Chairman, Co-CEO, and interim CFO. Watch execution and related-party conflicts, given buyer overlap with the new executive.
